query: Which two-sample tests and per-feature importance methods (Wasserstein, MMD, classifier two-sample test, SHAP/IG) best quantify simulation-to-reality fidelity for coda-wave features?

response.query: Which two-sample tests and per-feature importance methods (Wasserstein, MMD, classifier two-sample test, SHAP/IG) best quantify simulation-to-reality fidelity for coda-wave features?
response.answer: The Wasserstein distance and MMD (Maximum Mean Discrepancy) are best for two-sample tests; SHAP and IG are best for per-feature importance.
